panels.text: On 3 December 1992, a test engineer named Neil Papworth sends a message to a colleague's phone.
He works for Sema Group. The message goes over the Vodafone GSM network in the United Kingdom, from a personal computer to an Orbitel 901 handset.
It reaches Richard Jarvis, who works for Vodafone. The text of the message: "Merry Christmas."
It is the first SMS message sent. The first commercial short message service center followed in Sweden in 1993.

probes.question: What did the first SMS message say?
True or false: the first SMS was sent from a personal computer to a phone.

claims.note: Page text reads "to the Orbitel 901 phone of colleague Richard Jarvis".

claims.claim: Panel 2: He works for Sema Group; sent over the Vodafone GSM network in the UK from a personal computer to an Orbitel 901 handset
claims.quote: from Neil Papworth of Sema Group (now Mavenir Systems ) using a personal computer to Richard Jarvis of Vodafone using an Orbitel 901 handset

claims.claim: Panel 3: it reaches Richard Jarvis, who works for Vodafone; message text "Merry Christmas."
claims.quote: to Richard Jarvis of Vodafone using an Orbitel 901 handset. The text of the message was "Merry Christmas."
